comparison.objective: Trace the leaking coolant branch and shut only its associated valve.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual pipe tracing across crossings and quarter-turn lever actuation without disturbing other valves.
comparison.success_condition: Spraying valve at least 70 degrees shut, other valves under 20 degrees, hands clear for one second; wrong-valve motion past 45 degrees fails.
comparison.reason: It tests causal line tracing and selective isolation, not fine tool insertion, mechanical setting retention, or iterative impact calibration.
